public.text: The text says the Client Registry does not duplicate foundational identity data, but Appendix C later makes several demographic attributes mandatory in the Client Registry.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that the registry may retain the minimum demographic attributes required for health identity resolution, with provenance and synchronisation rules, rather than claiming that it does not duplicate any foundational data.
